children.value: > Fact From Story: The NMPA’s submission pulls no punches, stressing that its members are not opposed to AI.
> > Fact From Story: The NMPA states that great benefits could come from generative AI systems that can assist human creators.

> > > Fact From Story: The NMPA advocates for regulations and principles that it sees as the right approach to ensuring that the interests of musical artists don’t end up subjugated in the frenzy to build our brave new AI-powered world.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Advocating for regulation is a measured approach.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Being open to benefits is a form of not being opposed.
> Commonsense Knowledge: People can have a measured approach to new technology.
